title: Bit tricks
description:
Answer questions about a number with bit instructions.

```
Number: 52
binary: 00110100
is even: 1
lowest set bit: 4
times 8 (shift): 416
bits 2 and 4 cleared: 00100000
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Number: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        mov     rbx, rax

        mov     rdi, rbx
        mov     esi, 8
        call    print_bin
        call    print_newline
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `x & -x` keeps only the lowest set bit: `mov rax, rbx` / `neg rax` / `and rax, rbx` (lesson 2.03).
NASM works out constant expressions: `and rdi, ~((1 << 2) | (1 << 4))`.
requirements: `test` and `setz`/`setnz` (or `and`) for even, `and` with the negated value for the lowest set bit.
Clear bits with `and` and an inverted mask (`~((1 << 2) | (1 << 4))`).
stretch: Count the set bits with a loop of `shr` and `adc` (or with `popcnt` from lesson 7.05).
